newsitem.title: USA: Harnischfeger extends offer for Giddings.
newsitem.headline: Harnischfeger extends offer for Giddings.

text.p: Harnischfeger Industries Inc said Tuesday it had extended through May 30 its previously announced $19-a-share cash tender offer for Giddings & Lewis Inc.
The offer was previously scheduled to expire at midnight May 23.
Giddings has rejected Harnischfeger's offer, calling it inadequate.
Harnischfeger said it was advised that as of midnight May 23, about 1,023,127 shares of Giddings stock had been tendered and not withdrawn.
Harnischfeger also said it had delivered to Giddings, from holders of more than 10 percent of the outstanding Giddings shares, written demands to call a special meeting of shareholders.
Harnischfeger said the time, date, place and record date of the meeting have not been announced yet.
It said Giddings's bylaws require it to call a special meeting upon receipt of written demands from holders of more than 10 percent of outstanding Giddings shares.
At the special meeting, Giddings shareholders will have the opportunity to vote to remove the Giddings board and take other actions to facilitate Harnischfeger's tender offer, Harnischfeger said.
Harnischfeger makes mining, papermaking and material handling equipment.
